name: Cursifix
source:
A letter came from a far-off village in the western lands, imploring the cathedral for aid; a dark curse had warped the villagers into lumps of flesh. 

Father had forewarned me of the dreadful task ahead, but I could not turn away from those crying for help.

[From [url=https://hi-hamguin.itch.io/cursifix]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一封来自西部大地的偏远村庄的信，恳求大教堂提供援助；黑暗的诅咒将村民们扭曲成肉块。

父亲预先警告过我前面的任务是多么可怕，但我无法拒绝那些呼救的人。

[来自[url=https://hi-hamguin.itch.io/cursifix]Itch.io[/url]]
